ModMetaData.name: Pawn Idle Diagnostics 1.5 v1.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Exact work-chain diagnostic tracer for RimWorld 1.5. Arms only on real Wait_Wander (or manually), traces the next normal JobGiver_Work pass, records result stages around While You Are Nearby, and mirrors the vanilla 1.5 priority-group selection path only when the actual result is NoJob. Specifically detects the poisoned-target case where HasJob selects a target but JobOnThing/JobOnCell returns null and the next priorityInType transition terminates all lower work scanning. Does not issue jobs or modify AI results.
